'''2011 US Nationals John Anderson DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' T.T.O
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
